A fee may apply to credit card payments when law and card rules allow. The fee is capped at 3% or our actual card cost, whichever is lower. You will see the fee and full price before you pay. Debit and prepaid cards are not charged this fee.
Monthly and annual card-on-file rules apply even if you pay another way. Text Sandy to set up your plan.
Stripe supports credit and debit cards, plus eligible prepaid and gift cards linked to a supported card network.
Stripe supports Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, and China UnionPay, subject to account and regional rules.
Regional networks include Cartes Bancaires in France, Interac in Canada, and eftpos in Australia. Support can depend on your region and payment setup, including in-person payments.
Card brands, currencies, and saved-card use depend on the Stripe account country, your location, and payment setup. Text Sandy to check your card before you pay.
